scope: Preserve report-produced Decimal percentage strings through publication

frontend.command: npm test -- src/EvaluationView.test.tsx && npm run typecheck

regression_chain: generate_report creates report.json with string percentages
curated read-only API preserves exact percentage text
summary measured_count remains one and mean equals the original 25/20 percent measurements
Results component renders finite string percentages

numeric_boundary.accepted: Native finite numbers, or signed finite percentage strings with magnitude <=1e30, <=80 coefficient digits, absolute exponent <=80, text length <=160

history: Previous receipt and verification log left unchanged.
